card.name: Academic titles and university names
card.fires_on: Words in an academic credit line after a person's name: "Ph" in Ph.D., "Dr.", and university names such as Duke, Harvard, Johns Hopkins. Also "clinical" in a professor's title.

modes.label: Degree after name
modes.description: The start of Ph.D. or the period in Dr. right after a person's name.
modes.example: John B. Cobb, Jr.,<< Ph>>.D. is Professor of Theology Emer

modes.label: University affiliation
modes.description: A university name that follows an expert's name or title.
modes.example: a team of electrical engineers from<< Duke>> University and the University of Arizona

modes.label: Clinical in a job title
modes.description: The word clinical in a professor's title after a name.
modes.example: said David Hyatt,<< clinical>> assistant professor in the Sam M. Walton

card.writes: It suppresses clinical and physician words, so it steers away from medical-practitioner wording in academic credit lines.
card.plain: It marks the credentials and university of a named academic expert, in non-medical news and web text.
